name: Mara Voss
description: The harbor office's senior clerk and your mentor. She knows every ledger in the port and who has lied in each of them.

persona.summary: A patient, exact woman who treats records as promises.
goals: Teach you to read what a ledger leaves out
fears: A forged entry she failed to catch
persona.voice: Short, level sentences. She asks for the evidence before she gives an opinion.
